test_title: PYST 54: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 04 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word from the underlined words in the following sentence.

As __affidevit __is a statement or declaration in writing an oath or __affirmation__, sworn before a person having __authority __to __administer __oath.
solution:
The correct answer is option (1) i.e. **'affidevit'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **"Affidevit" **is incorrectly spelt in the given sentence.
 
• **The correct **spelling is** Affidavit **(शपथ पत्र) - A written statement confirmed by oath or affirmation, for use as evidence in court.
